body:
I don't see many positive reports on this which is why I'm writing this.  I recently obtained half of a 40mg disk from my friends C and A.  I decided to take it with a large glass of water while watching Futurama, this is important to note because large amounts of water always seem to make the Methadone trips better and Futurama puts me in a happy mindset.  I took the tab around 10:30.
11:30- The drug hits; suddenly, hard, and fast with not warning whatsever.  I feel a sense of security, which is an extreme treat for me considering my severe anxiety issues for which I am given Xanax.  Important to note I did not take my xanax so that my 'trip' would be clean and pure.
12:00- I turn on the radio and begin listening to rap.  I have a decent system and the bass seems to have an overwhelming sedating effect.  For the next few hours I drift in and of sleep.  During this period I have extremely vivid dreams.
3:00- I fall hard asleep.  Dreams are still vivid, but now I'm not going to the bathroom and eating and such in between.  It's just sleep.
6:00- The next morning i awake feeling refreshed.  I'm a person who usually requires a lot of sleep, 8 hours, so this is a shock to me.
The rest of the day is great still have the high feeling until about noon-time.
It's important to note that I used to be addicted to OxyContin, it has been a full 3 months since I used anything so my resistance is down, but at the height of my addiction I was insuffulating 100mg-160mg about three times a day.  I enjoy the opiate high, I always have and always will.  I can't make this a habit and I'd still be in deep if it weren't for my beautiful fiance and caring friends.
